Is there a truly unlimited Seedance 2.5 plan?

No. “Unlimited” here means unlimited generations inside these limits:

  • a time window of 7 to 30 days
  • a clip cap of 20 to 30 seconds
  • a resolution cap (480p, 720p, 1080p depending on plan)
  • web app only (no API, MCP or CLI)
  • speed that may be slowed in busy periods

Assumptions:

  • The whole checkout price is counted against Seedance 2.5. The plans also include monthly credits and other unlimited models, so this overstates the break-even if you use those too.
  • Annual plans are billed yearly, so “you pay” is 12 months at the per-month price. One month’s share is shown under it.
  • Every second you generate in the window is one you would otherwise have paid the API for. Retries count, because the API bills them too.
  • API rows are matched on resolution only. Audio, input type and clip-length differences between an API row and the plan are not adjusted.
  • Taxes are excluded, as on the vendor pages.

When unlimited beats per-second, and when it doesn't

  • Lowest daily bar: Higgsfield Ultra (monthly) needs about 25 seconds of 720p video a day for 14 days to beat $0.2312/s on Replicate.
  • Highest daily bar: Higgsfield Scale (annual) needs about 693 seconds a day over 30 days if you count the full checkout price against the window.
  • Unlimited wins when you will generate a lot in a short, known stretch: batch work, many re-rolls of the same shot, or testing prompts before a paid render.
  • Per-second wins when you need fewer seconds than the break-even, need the API or automation (the windows are web app only), need a deadline you can count on (speed can be slowed in busy periods), or need a clip length or resolution above the plan's cap.
  • Only Higgsfield Ultra (annual) includes 1080p in the window. Every other live window stops at 720p or lower.

Checklist before you pay

  1. Check the exact model. Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 windows are listed separately, and some plans unlock only 2.0.
  2. Match the billing toggle. The same plan name has a different window, clip cap and resolution on monthly and annual billing.
  3. Read the resolution and clip cap for your plan, and compare them with the length you actually need.
  4. Note the renewal price. A first-month sale price renews at the full monthly price.
  5. Plan for the web app only. Unlimited generations do not run through the API, MCP or CLI.
  6. Leave slack in your deadline. The vendor says unlimited speed can be adjusted during high traffic.
  7. Look for an Unlimited switch in the model menu. Higgsfield's August guide said generations drew from credits unless it was on.
  8. Count your break-even seconds with the table above before you pay.

Does unlimited Seedance 2.5 work on the API?

No. Higgsfield says unlimited models are accessible only on higgsfield.ai, not on MCP/CLI, Canvas or Supercomputer. API calls are billed per second; the cheapest rates are on the Seedance 2.5 model page.

Is Runway's Seedance 2.5 unlimited?

Not any more. We saw it gone on 2026-11-11: Pro and Max list Seedance 2.5 as a model with no Unlimited label. The Unlimited badge is on Topaz AI Upscale.

Is there free unlimited Seedance 2.5?

Starter lists no Seedance 2.5 unlimited window on the pricing page. We found no free unlimited Seedance 2.5 offer on the vendor pages we track. Every live window is part of a paid plan.

Is there an unlimited Wan 3.0 plan?

Not in our deal data right now. The last Wan 3.0 unlimited window we tracked has ended, and Higgsfield's pricing page lists Wan 3.0 at credit rates.
